title: Megan Thee Stallion Earns Multiple New RIAA Certifications as ‘Savage’ Hits 6x Platinum
summary: Cardi B and Meg's "WAP" also became certified Diamond earlier in August.
contentText:
Megan Thee Stallion will need to make some space in the trophy room. The Houston Hottie picked up nine new certifications from the Recording Industry Association of America on Monday (Aug. 17).

Related

Megan Thee Stallion Finds ‘Good Luck’ Charm in Orange Cat She Named Miso While Recording ‘Act III’

Megan Thee Stallion Signs Distribution Partnership With Interscope Records: ‘Act: III Is on Thee Way’

Megan Thee Stallion Teases ‘Act III’ Album: ‘I’m Back’

Meg’s Billboard Hot 100 -topping “Savage” is now 6x Platinum, while her “Body” and “Girls in the Hood” anthems reached triple-Platinum status, according to the RIAA’s website . The Yuki Chiba-assisted “Mamushi,” which reached the Hot 100’s top 40 (No. 36), is now Platinum.

There are plenty of gold plaques on the way as well. Megan’s Act II album is Gold, in addition to “Cobra,” “BOA,” “Bigger in Texas” and “Roc Steady” featuring Flo Milli.

The 31-year-old rapper reacted by reposting the news of the certifications to her Instagram Story with a series of CD emojis.

On Aug. 3, Megan Thee Stallion earned her first Diamond plaque for her 2020 “WAP” collaboration with Cardi B, which topped the Hot 100 for four weeks and marks the Bronx native’s fourth Diamond certification.

“Awww y’all WAP just went diamond… me and @theestallion really did that!! Love y’all so much… thank you for streaming and making history with us #WAP,” Cardi wrote on X at the time.

Megan replied: “WOWW omg diamond sisterrr thank you for having me!”

WOWW omg diamond sisterrr thank you for having me💎💎💎 https://t.co/CGHAKQj29e

— TINA SNOW (@theestallion) August 3, 2026

The Houston Hottie now turns her attention to Act III , which she’s continued to tease along with the return of her Tina Snow alter ego on the upcoming LP.

When the project — which currently doesn’t have a release date — does arrive, it will be through a new distribution partnership , as Megan Thee Stallion has inked a deal with Interscope Records. The agreement allows Meg to keep her publishing and masters, while releasing music through her Hot Girl Productions company.
